desc: Verify the gap-reversal model: operation reverses the three gaps (g_i, g_{i+1}, g_{i+2}) → (g_{i+2}, g_{i+1}, g_i); endpoints x_1, x_N immovable; validated on sample 1 (gaps 4,2,3 → 3,2,4, sum 21 ✓).
Reachability: distance-2 swaps generate full symmetric group within each parity class of gap indices; any i in 1..N−3 is always applicable.

Sum formula: total = N·x_1 + Σ_{k=1}^{N−1} (N−k)·g_k; minimize via rearrangement — ascending gaps to increasing indices within each parity class (largest gap ↔ smallest weight). Verified: sample 1 → 21 ✓, sample 2 → 41 ✓.
Write final Python solution with fast I/O, O(N log N), integer arithmetic; output the minimum sum.
